summary: Broad crypto sentiment today is mixed to cautiously bullish on major assets, with Bitcoin and Ethereum holding key support while traders wait for U.S. CPI and macro confirmation. Several technical desks still see downside risk or range compression, but dip-buying interest is visible in BTC, ETH, SOL, and gold.[1][2][8][13][14][16]
